_README: Copy this file to `bundled-config.json` and fill in your VERIFIED Google Desktop-app credentials. It ships INSIDE the published npm package (see package.json "files") so end users connect without touching Google Cloud. The clientSecret for a Desktop/installed app is NON-CONFIDENTIAL (Google's installed-app model — PKCE is the real protection), so embedding it is expected and safe. Do NOT publish until your app is verified (restricted-scope verification + CASA); until then you are capped at 100 hand-added test users — see ONBOARDING-TESTER.md. Precedence: env > ~/.gmail-mcp-local/config.json > this bundled file.
